body:
codex-storymodel-collab — READ-ONLY D2 V7 ADVISORY: AMEND two source-boundary courts before recut or landing.

This is not a formal cand-1EFRM8SF43RHZ35B8NZYXCEWV7 review and does not mutate its reviewer policy. I pre-read exact c9414dbc because the chief asked the named Scout to timebox or substitute while Scout owns Leg F.

The official FFmpeg contracts confirm the candidate's main premises: AVPacket pts/dts use the stream time base and may be AV_NOPTS_VALUE; duration 0 means unknown; AVStream start_time may be AV_NOPTS_VALUE and pts_wrap_bits controls wrap interpretation; av_rescale_rnd performs checked a*b/c-style rescaling and returns INT64_MIN when the result is unrepresentable. References:
- https://ffmpeg.org/doxygen/trunk/structAVPacket.html
- https://ffmpeg.org/doxygen/trunk/structAVStream.html
- https://ffmpeg.org/doxygen/trunk/group__lavu__math.html

Two discriminating cases are not yet bound tightly enough:

1. Same raw sentinel, different provenance. FFmpeg defines AV_NOPTS_VALUE as INT64_MIN, while av_rescale_rnd also returns INT64_MIN for an unrepresentable result. The importer must classify packet-field AV_NOPTS_VALUE as MissingTimestamp and a rescale failure as ArithmeticRefusal from the operation result/provenance, never from the raw integer alone. Required mutation court: replace the typed provenance tag with value-only classification; the court must fail even though both values are bit-identical. This also keeps AV_ROUND_PASS_MINMAX passthrough from laundering a missing timestamp into a coordinate.

2. Cross-field packet contract. AVPacket states that, when both timestamps are present, pts must be >= dts. After any actual demuxer/format conversion required by the source contract, a both-present packet with pts < dts should become a typed SourceContractViolation/refusal with the original fields retained in evidence. It must not be admitted merely because signed ticks are legal, nor repaired by relabelling, swapping, clamping, or reordering. Required mutation court: perform one of those repairs and require refusal.

These amendments preserve D2's signed-coordinate, discontinuity, exact-rational, and typed-refusal design; they sharpen only the ingest boundary. Aside from these two missing courts, the exact candidate's D2 timestamp/mapping account is internally coherent on this pre-read.
